canDoYue: 你識問實報實銷、差額、採購同帳簿。
canDoEn: Ask about a reimbursement, a variance, procurement, and the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you please bring the March reimbursement and the cost variance to Monday's procurement review?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以帶三月實報實銷同成本差額，去星期一嘅採購審核？
dialogue.say: Could you please bring the March reimbursement and the cost variance to Monday's procurement review?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will bring that March reimbursement, and the cost variance matches our written ledger.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會帶三月實報實銷，成本差額同我哋書面帳簿一致。
dialogue.say: I will bring that March reimbursement, and the cost variance matches our written ledger.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will you approve the full variance if procurement keeps it inside the written March ledger?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果採購將差額留喺三月書面帳簿入面，你會唔會批核成個差額？
dialogue.say: Will you approve the full variance if procurement keeps it inside the written March ledger?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will approve that full variance on Monday, because procurement kept it inside the file.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期一會批核嗰個成個差額，因為採購將佢留喺檔案入面。
dialogue.say: I will approve that full variance on Monday, because procurement kept it inside the file.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please could the ledger name me as the owner without reading every reimbursement line aloud?
dialogue.glossYue: 帳簿可唔可以寫我做負責人，唔使大聲讀每一行實報實銷？
dialogue.say: Please could the ledger name me as the owner without reading every reimbursement line aloud?

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: The notes will name me as owner, and I will not read every line aloud.
dialogue.glossYue: 筆記會寫我做負責人，我唔會大聲讀每一行。
dialogue.say: The notes will name me as owner, and I will not read every line aloud.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please file the procurement note before the meeting and leave it on my wooden desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 開會之前請將採購字條歸檔，並放喺我張木檯。
dialogue.say: Please file the procurement note before the meeting and leave it on my wooden desk.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: I will file that note before we start, and it can stay on your desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 開始之前我會將嗰張字條歸檔，佢可以留喺你張檯。
dialogue.say: I will file that note before we start, and it can stay on your desk.
